title: Spicy Aji Pasta
description: A Japanese-inspired pasta dish with a spicy kick from aji peppers. Serve immediately for the best results.

ingredients.name: umami
ingredients.notes: Dried seaweed or mushroom powder can be used as a substitute

ingredients.name: ac crunchy
ingredients.notes: Sesame seeds can be used as a substitute

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a small saucepan, heat the umami over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the sliced aji peppers to the saucepan and cook until they start to soften.
Add the cooked pasta to the saucepan and toss with the aji pepper mixture.
Sprinkle the ac crunchy on top of the pasta and toss to combine.
